svg.aria-label: PlanCast, animated: four recent point-cloud frames enter the world model, which gives every patch a motion feature and a forecast. The motion feature is gated into the scene tokens, between the eight flow passes each draft is checked against the forecast, the selector keeps the candidate with the fewest predicted contacts, two steps are executed and the planner replans.
